categories.label: Food & drinks
categories.rule: meals, snacks, drinks, cafes, the food is the subject

categories.label: Travel & nature
categories.rule: mountains, beaches, landscapes, monuments, trips, sky and sunsets

categories.label: City & nights out
categories.rule: streets, buildings, malls, cars, concerts, events, night city

categories.label: Home & everyday
categories.rule: rooms, desk setups, objects, shopping, products, anything everyday

categories.label: Documents & receipts
categories.rule: photos of paper (IDs, bills, notes, whiteboards) and screenshots of payments, bookings, tickets, orders

categories.label: Memes & saved posts
categories.rule: screenshots of other people's posts, reels, tweets, articles, memes, ideas saved for later

categories.label: Other screenshots
categories.rule: any other screenshot: chats, apps, settings, maps, emails

categories.label: Talking & selfie videos
categories.rule: a person talking to the camera, vlogs, selfie videos

categories.label: Screen recordings
categories.rule: recordings of a phone or computer screen

categories.label: Everyday clips
categories.rule: every other video: friends, family, pets, food, events

categories.rule: invoices, bills, receipts, bank statements, salary slips, insurance, tax papers, tickets
